body:
# Customer Data Platform

A modern ETL/ELT and visualization framework delivered actionable insights, improved marketing decisions, and built a strong foundation for AI-driven analytics.

A global pharmaceutical giant faced a major challenge—how to unify marketing data from over 50 different sources, including in-house, third-party, and market research data, into a single, reliable source of truth. They needed a Customer Data Platform (CDP) that could seamlessly ingest, standardize, and analyze data to measure campaign effectiveness across multiple markets.

### Our Approach

Connected 50+ marketing sources into secure ingestion pipelines across batch and streaming.

Standardized entities and attributes with automated transformations for a trusted customer view.

Applied governance, lineage, and quality rules to keep datasets reliable for analytics and AI.

Delivered BI-ready models and dashboards enabling faster campaign optimization across markets.

To tackle this, Ampera Tech AI developed a cutting-edge data engineering and analytics solution, leveraging AWS, Snowflake, Denodo, and advanced BI tools like Tableau & MicroStrategy. Our hybrid batch and streaming data pipelines ensured real-time data processing and transformation, while data governance with Collibra maintained accuracy and compliance.
